summary.suggested: The St. Louis Democrat reported that Judge Snyder at Belleville discharged Tom Allen and four others from their indictment over the Allen-McCoole prize fight in Madison County, Illinois, because of a flaw in the indictment.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The St. Louis Democrat', Tuesday, February 2, 1875 (before the Globe-Democrat merger).

facts.fact: Allen, Jack Looney, Arthur Chambers, Dublin Tricks and Tom Kelley were discharged by Judge Snyder of the St. Clair County Circuit Court from a Madison County indictment over the Allen-McCoole prize fight, owing to a flaw in the indictment
The case had been moved on a change of venue from Madison County to St. Clair County, Illinois

notes: Discharge was 'on Saturday' before the Feb 2 paper, i.e. 1875-01-30.
